earthquake_partitions.disjointness_guarantee: Train ∩ Val = Train ∩ Test = Val ∩ Test = ∅

P1_Source_Only.description: Trained strictly on SOURCE_A to measure raw zero-shot inductive transfer without structural diversity

P2_Multi_Structure.description: Multi-structure training: Reuses the exact 70 standard + 20 pair SOURCE_A simulations from P1 and adds 35 simulations per B_train structure across RSN0001..70
P2_Multi_Structure.source_a_reuse: Reuses exact 90 simulations from P1 (70 standard + 20 pairs)

validation_accounting.formula: 20 earthquakes × 2 structures = 40 standard simulations (+ 10 SOURCE_A pairs = 20 runs)

test_evaluation_hierarchy.earthquakes: RSN0091 to RSN0120 (30 strictly held-out earthquakes, N=30 independent samples per level)

Level_2A_Interpolation.allocation: 15 earthquakes on B_int_1 + 15 earthquakes on B_int_2

Level_2B_Extrapolation.allocation: 15 earthquakes on B_ext_soft + 15 earthquakes on B_ext_stiff

observability_gate_semantics.rule: The observability protocol is frozen. During Phase 7.1, C_4story must undergo SVD and Fisher analysis before inverse model evaluation. If C_4story fails observability, classify as F1 physical non-observability and do not interpret inverse degradation as an ML failure.

statistical_unit_policy.pseudoreplication_ban: 30 earthquakes × 3 seeds CANNOT be pooled into N=90 independent observations. Binary Clopper-Pearson CIs use N=30 independent earthquake cases for each seed/condition. Seed-to-seed variance is reported separately as mean ± SD.

model_conditions.name: Full Physics Conditioned G-FNO
model_conditions.conditioning: Local mechanical features (m_v, A_e, I_e, E_0)

model_conditions.name: Symmetry-Aware Physics G-FNO
model_conditions.conditioning: Full physics + latent symmetry + pairwise loss
